source: user-supplied HackerOne Resolved and rewarded adjudications
purpose: positive controls for capability-delta, protected-consumer, and report-ready triage

cases.starting_authority: Author can upload and edit only an attachment they own
cases.attacker_input: client-side media finalization stores attacker-controlled attachment filenames in metadata
cases.consumer_chain: poisoned size metadata is copied into backup metadata and later consumed by attachment deletion
cases.protected_sink: filesystem deletion whose target and confinement directory are both derived from attacker-controlled metadata
cases.resulting_capability: deletion of a PHP-process-writable file outside the uploads and document roots
cases.capability_delta: an Author gains a filesystem deletion capability unavailable through the intended media role
cases.production_reachability: released Gutenberg path and independently reproduced WordPress core trunk path intended for HTTPS production
cases.negative_controls: Contributor was rejected and Author access to an Administrator-owned attachment was rejected
cases.manual_proof: researcher-owned canary files were deleted in throwaway labs with before-and-after filesystem evidence
cases.safe_proof_rule: use only disposable canary files and stop after proving boundary escape; never delete real configuration or third-party data
cases.future_disposition: the exact finalize-to-backup-size deletion root is public and fixed; use KILL_KNOWN_OR_DUPLICATE unless a current release has a distinct bypass or consumer

cases.starting_authority: Author can upload and edit only an attachment they own and lacks unfiltered_html
cases.attacker_input: client-side media finalization stores an attacker-controlled sub-size filename verbatim
cases.consumer_chain: image metadata is converted into an image URL and rendered without contextual escaping in authenticated administration views
cases.protected_sink: Administrator browser execution in the wp-admin origin
cases.resulting_capability: stored script execution across the Author-to-Administrator privilege boundary
cases.capability_delta: an Author without script-posting authority gains code execution in a higher-privileged Administrator session
cases.production_reachability: released Gutenberg path and independently reproduced WordPress core trunk path with browser execution
cases.negative_controls: Contributor and cross-owner attachment writes were rejected, clean neighboring attachments did not inject, and unaffected views were checked
cases.manual_proof: real browser execution changed an observable property in the Administrator session on genuine administration URLs
cases.safe_proof_rule: use an inert DOM canary in a disposable owned lab and do not create users, install plugins, steal nonces, or perform post-exploitation
cases.future_disposition: the exact finalize-to-unescaped-media-view root is public and fixed; use KILL_KNOWN_OR_DUPLICATE unless a current release has a distinct bypass or consumer
